description: Fetches transit infrastructure project data (construction details, costs, references) from the Transit Costs Project database at transitcosts.com.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_project: Get detailed information for a specific transit project by URL; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - list_projects: List all transit projects with optional city/country filters; 参数: limit, city, country; 必填: 无
  - search_projects: Search projects by name with optional filters; 参数: limit, query, city, country; 必填: 无

url.description: Project page URL from transitcosts.com (required for get_project function).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (for list_projects and search_projects).

city.description: Filter results by city name (for list_projects and search_projects).

country.description: Filter results by country code (e.g., US, CN, UK) for list_projects and search_projects.

query.description: Search query for project name (required for search_projects).
